model_effort_basis: Delegation configuration stated by parent; no runtime model introspection performed.
fast_tier: No separately exposed Fast tier in the delegation tool.

exposure.available_context: Scoped delegated assignment, system/developer/tool instructions, and supplied environment context only.

retained_contract_expressions: Dependency type import names/path and complete supplied public type declarations are retained.
Contributor object keys, order, literals, and direct input-field accesses are contract-prescribed and retained, including own optional-valued keys.
Category projection retains the ordinary method-receiver map.get(source), falsy absence check, shallow spread, and contributors override required by the contract.
These thin mappings may match existing field expressions; they are explicitly retained contract data, not claimed as novel expressions.
discretionary_choices: Four-space indentation and multiline import/function parameter formatting.
Local category binding named category, single-line falsy return, and inline shallow-spread return.
No added helpers, persistent state, normalization, validation, aggregation, or extra output fields.
validation: No tests, builds, typechecks, lint, mocks, or compiler tools run. Python standard-library hashing was used only for the receipt.
